description: Angular component for a dashboard state dialog in the Thingsboard UI, managing creation and editing of dashboard states with form validation and user interaction logic.

classes.name: DashboardStateDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing dashboard state creation and editing dialog.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form controls, and subscribes to form value changes.

methods.name: checkStateName
methods.description: Automatically generates a state ID from the name if not touched and in add mode.

methods.name: validateDuplicateStateId
methods.description: Validator function to prevent duplicate state IDs.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if the form control is in an error state for validation display.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and submits the form data, closing the dialog with the new or updated state.
